title: My Birthday Party
hook: 佩奇生日那天一早全家送礼物，爸爸扮成魔术师表演，最后端出香蕉蛋糕。

cells.a: It is very early in the morning on Peppa's birthday.
cells.cn: 故事从佩奇生日那天天刚亮开始。

cells.q: Why is Peppa up so early in the morning?
cells.a: She is far too excited to stay in bed on her birthday.
cells.cn: 生日这天她太兴奋了，根本躺不住。

cells.a: She got a doll's dress and she puts it on Teddy.
cells.cn: 她得到一条娃娃裙，马上给泰迪穿上。

cells.a: Daddy Pig is the magician, but no one will know.
cells.cn: 魔术师就是猪爸爸，不过别人都不知道。

cells.q: What did Mummy Pig call out?
cells.a: She called the children because the party is starting.
cells.cn: 她喊孩子们，因为派对要开始了。

cells.q: What did the magician ask Suzy?
cells.a: He asked her to tell the audience her name.
cells.cn: 他让她告诉观众自己的名字。

cells.q: How does the ball trick work?
cells.a: Suzy picks a ball while his back is turned.
cells.cn: 趁他转过身，苏西挑了一个球。

cells.q: What did Daddy Pig ask the children?
cells.a: He asked if they would like one more trick.
cells.cn: 他问孩子们还想不想再看一个戏法。

cells.q: What did Peppa say about her birthday?
cells.a: She said it is her best birthday ever.
cells.cn: 她说这是她过得最棒的生日。

ending: In the end, Peppa gets a banana birthday cake. My favourite part is ______.
